# Project Instructions

This repository contains standalone Python learning examples covering data processing, classical machine learning, neural networks, attention, embeddings, and text generation.

- Keep changes focused on the example being edited; avoid introducing project-wide frameworks or unnecessary abstractions.
- Preserve the educational, step-by-step nature of examples and explain only non-obvious logic with concise comments.
- Follow the conventions of the neighboring file. Do not assume every script shares a common API or execution flow.
- When changing an example, validate it with the narrowest relevant check. Some scripts require optional packages or external model downloads.
- Do not change unrelated examples or silently replace the algorithm being demonstrated.

Common dependencies in the examples include NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, Transformers, and Sentence Transformers. Check the selected script's imports and runtime needs before running it.
